Jazz Angels Grants — proof of concept

One place for every grant: where it is in its life (Prospect → LOI → Applying → Submitted → Awarded → Active → Reporting → Closed), what is due when, and once awarded, where the money went.

Read left to right, top to bottom. Screens reuse the Jazz Angels staff-portal design system (blue rail, warm paper, Jost headings).

Why the Playbook matters

Today one person knows the whole process. The Playbook turns that into checklist templates: adding a grant copies one, and every task gets a due date worked out from the application deadline. Anyone in the office can follow it.
